origin.description: Run code, then close each named connection.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: Mapping of names to open files.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run before the files are closed.

origin.details: Names are required. Each value needs close(). The callable may take the connection names as arguments, or close over them.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile()
with_connection(list(con = file(path, "w")), writeLines(c("foo", "bar"), con))
readLines(path)

translation.description: Run code, then close each named connection.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: Mapping of names to open files.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run before the files are closed.

translation.details: Names are required. Each value needs close(). The callable may take the connection names as arguments, or close over them. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
con = open(path, "w")
with_connection({"con": con}, lambda: con.write("foo\nbar\n"))
with open(path) as handle:
    lines = handle.read().splitlines()
os.remove(path)
return lines
